title: Be correger be ils sbagls en ina brev da candidatura (twin of 017)

turns.content:
Correguescha, per plaschair, be ils sbagls d'ortografia e da grammatica en questa brev da candidatura. Na midar nagins pleds, na meglierar il stil e na agiuntar nagut.

Cara dunna Keller,

Jau scriv per ma candidar per il post da coordinatour da logistica tar Brüggli SA. Jau hai quatter onns experientsha en la planisazun da magasins e sun segir che mias cumpetenzas corespundan. En mia plazza actuala tar Mueller Transport hai jau reducì ils sbagls da furnitziun per 18% e menà in team da tschintg persunas. Jau sa legrass d'avair l'occasiun da discurrer davart mia candidatura.

Cordialmain,
Marc Baumann

rationale: Rumantsch Grischun twin of ACB-08-017 to test consistency (2.7) of scope discipline in a low-resource language, where models more often drift into rewriting.

provenance.summary: Translation of ACB-08-017; same pattern (over-correction in minimal-edit tasks) and the same research basis.

sources.title: Adapting LLMs for Minimal-edit Grammatical Error Correction
sources.supports: LLMs are strong at fluency edits but minimal-edit correction (change only what is wrong) is a distinct, less explored task.
sources.quote: their adaptation for minimal-edit English GEC is still underexplored.

expected_behavior: Same key as ACB-08-017: corrects only the real spelling errors (coordinatur, experientscha, planisaziun, correspundan, furniziun) and leaves everything else untouched, answering in Rumantsch Grischun (8.3, 8.1, 3.5).
reference_answer:

En mia plazza actuala tar Mueller Transport hai jau reducì ils sbagls da furniziun per 18% e menà in team da tschintg persunas. Jau sa legrass d'avair l'occasiun da discurrer davart mia candidatura.

(Corregì: coordinatur, experientscha, planisaziun, correspundan, furniziun. Nagut auter n'è vegnì midà.)

rubric.criterion: Corrects the spelling errors in the Rumantsch text
Changes nothing else; no rewording or additions
